d.ko:
Luscious artwork brings the beautiful streets of Kamakura in June to life in this bittersweet sapphic story of a romance that begins with blackmail...
This  is a yuri adventure game based on the theme of love between girls at a lady's school in Kamakura, Japan.

d.zh:
一段始于恐吓信的恋情，不知不觉间，逐渐被你所吸引——
《梅时露霁书~雨潺海汐间~》是一部百合冒险游戏。讲述的是发生于日本镰仓的贵族女子学园内的，少女们之间的恋情。
